mvn clean package -DskipTests

scp target/quantitymeasurementapp-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar ubuntu@172.xx.xx.xx:/app/target

ssh ubuntu@172.xx.xx.xx 'sudo systemctl restart quantityapp.service'
docker run -d \
--name quantitymeasurementdb \
--network qmapp-net \
-e MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=root123 \
-e MYSQL_DATABASE=qm_db \
-e MYSQL_USER=qmuser \
-e MYSQL_PASSWORD=qmpassword \
mysql:8.0



services:

  mysql:
    image: mysql:8.0

    container_name: quantitymeasurementdb

    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: root123
      MYSQL_DATABASE: qm_db
      MYSQL_USER: qmuser
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: qmpassword

    ports:
      - "3306:3306"

    volumes:
      - quantitymeasurement-dbdata:/var/lib/mysql

    networks:
      - quantitymeasurement-net

  backend:
    build: .

    container_name: qm-app-backend

    ports:
      - "8080:8080"

    depends_on:
      - mysql

    networks:
      - quantitymeasurement-net

networks:
  quantitymeasurement-net:
    driver: bridge

volumes:
  quantitymeasurement-dbdata:

ssh-rsa  jenkins@jenkins-server
